ctx.x: All these things had to do with changing my viewpoints about music, and my listening ear, and my rebellion against this atmosphere that I was growing up in. In other words at 12 years old I realized that I was growing up in a dual atmosphere, one that my father required me to be a saintly gentleman, and immediately when I would go -- on my way to school I'd find out that I was not living in that world of Jesus Christ, but a world of reality where there was physical strife and conflict, you know.
